title: 1073 Topsail Road: level entrance area and accessible service counter
code_edition: Buildings Accessibility Act and Regulations, including O.C. 96-865; edition not stated

facts.text: The building was constructed in 1988 with a 1991 addition; the decision says no new construction/additions had occurred since 1991.
A 2019 order required a 1,500 mm by 1,500 mm level area at the front door and an accessible public-counter section.
The inspector described the adjacent area as approximately 1,375 mm; the tribunal also discusses a 13 mm change-in-level limit and ramp treatment.

limitations: Comparative source from outside Alberta; it cannot establish Alberta code performance or approval.
